representativeSnapshot.kind: local Supabase schema with the current ticketing foundation

rowCountQueries: Count ticket_types rows whose event_id does not resolve directly or through events.promoted_event_v2_id
Count accepted booking_requests without a resolvable events_v2 event
Count confirmed or active employment_assignments without a resolvable events_v2 event
Count existing ticket_allocations and ticket_inventory_reservations by lifecycle status
preflight.expectedAffectedRows: The audited guest-list, allocation, and complimentary-ticket tables were empty; any newly unresolved event links are recorded rather than guessed

execution.resumeStrategy: All additive objects are guarded, backfills update only unresolved or legacy-linked rows, and named policies are recreated deterministically
execution.idempotency: Tables, columns, indexes, and extensions use IF NOT EXISTS; backfill issue records use stable keys with ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING; ticketing authorization dynamically detects optional legacy helpers

quarantine.strategy: Record unresolved ticket, booking, and employment event links for manual review; never infer an events_v2 identifier

constraints: ticket_types_event_id_fkey is created NOT VALID and validated only when all rows resolve
ticket_allocations lifecycle, purpose, and quantity checks use NOT VALID then VALIDATE
ticket_inventory_reservations consumed bounds use NOT VALID then VALIDATE
event_attendance event-table check is expanded with NOT VALID then VALIDATE so accepted events_v2 tickets can populate Upcoming Events
ticket_invites recipient, email, purpose, status, and send-count checks are created with the new table
indexes: ticket allocation lifecycle and reservation indexes
invite allocation, event, recipient, and active-recipient uniqueness indexes
booking and employment events_v2 eligibility indexes
constraintsAndIndexes.validationPlan: Verify constraints and RLS with creator, delegated manager, recipient, service-role, and unrelated-user personas, including an environment without can_ticketing_on_event or has_event_ticketing_grant; confirm accepted tickets are wallet-readable and their events appear in Upcoming Events; run quota and inventory concurrency tests

recovery.rollback: Disable the server feature flag and apply a reviewed forward migration that removes new wrappers and policies; retain invite and ownership records for auditability
recovery.forwardFix: Apply additive corrections for constraints, policies, or backfills, then re-run unresolved-link and inventory reconciliation queries

queries: Verify unresolved event links in private.ticketing_migration_issues
Verify all new constraints and the ticket_types FK validation state
Verify RLS and effective grants for ticket_allocation_managers and ticket_invites
Reconcile allocation totals, reservation quantities, reserved inventory, issued tickets, and active invites
Run Supabase security and performance advisors for affected tables and functions
